story: Ambulance and nonmedical transport on one invoice

insurer_error.description: Transport disallowed above combined ambulance cap

letter_deductions.deduction: Transport disallowed above combined ambulance cap
letter_deductions.why: The road ambulance trip sheet confirms a medically indicated transfer to the admitting hospital. The separate ride receipt is for the patient's family after discharge, with no ambulance or medical service. Only the Rs 1,600 road ambulance charge enters the Rs 2,000 cap calculation.
